mapper.insert: INSERT INTO holdings_replica (user_id, stock_code, quantity, avg_buy_price, currency, synced_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{stockCode}, #{quantity}, #{avgBuyPrice}, #{currency}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = VALUES(quantity), avg_buy_price = VALUES(avg_buy_price), currency = VALUES(currency), synced_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM holdings_replica WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND stock_code = #{stockCode}
